title: West Sixth Law
description:
Overview

Country: Columbus, Indiana, United States | Website: agslawyers.com | Revenue: $5 Million | Industry: Law Firms & Legal Services | Employees: 11-50 Employees | Properties: 328 GB (708,816 Files, 47,925 Folders)
Detailed Analysis

West Sixth Law is a law firm based in Madison, Indiana, specializing in personal injury, family law, criminal defense, estate planning, workers compensation, and social security disability. The company's employees didn't take their security seriously, and the password for all critical IT infrastructure was “Qwerty123” lol. Data from major high-profile cases—which had been presented in court and for which people had chosen to trust “West Sixth Law”—was compromised, but due to negligence, we were able to steal all of it.
